title: Add persistent local agent status console
description: Add a persistent local NEWERP AI Agent console that displays durable project/task/Git/CI status, safely fast-forwards clean managed branches, and starts the guarded local pipeline for runnable tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Repository root provides start_agent.bat for launching the persistent local Agent console.
Console displays project phase, current/completed task, queue, Git sync state, validation/browser status, blocker, runner state, and recent runner output without printing secrets.
Clean main/master/develop worktrees can fast-forward from origin and automatically start the guarded pipeline for runnable pending/retry tasks.
Dirty worktrees, paused state, and L3/L4 or explicit human-approval gates prevent unsafe automatic execution.
CI includes a no-execute one-shot smoke test for the Agent console.
GitHub Actions run 35816664437 completes successfully for commit 3ab08fec153d125d659b540a9aa220e04dae870b.

browser_acceptance.note: Control-plane change was validated by the CI Agent console smoke test and approved UI smoke job against the test environment.

human_gate.reason: Local automation control-plane/status-host change only; production and irreversible operations remain gated.
